rows.question: Can I resit an exam I already passed to get a higher grade?
rows.answer: You cannot resit an exam you already passed to get a higher grade.

rows.question: Is a final mark of 5.45 a pass?
rows.answer: According to [1], a final mark between 5 and 6 will be rounded to the nearest whole number. Since 5.45 is below 5.50, it will be rounded down. Therefore, a final mark of 5.45 is not a pass.

rows.question: When am I allowed to start my Master Project AI?
rows.answer: You are allowed to start your Master Project AI after having successfully completed 60 ECTS (in total) of the MSc Artificial Intelligence. [1]

rows.question: How many EC is the Master Project AI?
rows.answer: You. The Master Project AI is worth 30 EC. [1]

rows.question: I already completed Advanced Machine Learning. Can I take Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning?
rows.answer: You cannot take Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning (XM_0189) because you have already completed the course XM_0010 Advanced Machine Learning, which has been replaced by XM_0189 [3].

rows.question: What is the deadline to request an extra exam opportunity, and who qualifies?
rows.answer: According to Article 4.2 of the Artificial Intelligence TER 2026-2027, the deadline to request an extra exam opportunity is 15 July. Additionally, a student must have completed all but one unit of education to meet the requirements of the degree and have failed the examination during all the previously offered attempts, unless participation in an examination was not possible for compelling reasons.

rows.question: How long after an exam can I inspect my graded work?
rows.answer: According to Article 3.9 of the General programme rule, you have the right to inspect your graded examination within twenty working days after the announcement of the results of a written examination, but at least ten working days before the resit opportunity for that examination.
